author: Katherine Schaffstall
title: Jon Bon Jovi's Nashville Bar Is for Sale With Whopping Listing Price - NewsBreak
text:
By Katherine Schaffstall ,
1 hours ago
Jon Bon Jovi is switching up his résumé, revealing that his bar in Nashville, Tennessee, is up for sale with a whopping listing price just more than one year after he was opened.
Real Estate company Surmount CRE announced that JBJ’s Nashville is on the market in a Facebook post shared on Wednesday, October 1. "We’re proud to present the tallest bar on Nashville’s Lower Broadway: Jon Bon Jovi’s – Nashville,” the company wrote, revealing that the building has been listed for $130,000,000 listing.
JBJ’s Nashville is located in the heart of downtown Nashville’s iconic Lower Broadway entertainment district at 405 Broadway. The building spans 36,767 square feet, making it the second-largest venue on Lower Broadway. Additionally, the listing stated that the venue is “structured as a 20-year [triple-net] NNN sale-leaseback with 2 percent annual rental increases.”
"This is a truly generational chance to own a trophy asset in one of America’s busiest entertainment corridors," the real estate company added the prospective buyers.
JBJ's Nashville had its grand opening in June 2024. According to the website , the venue includes "eight bars, five floors, three stages, and two rooftops — including the highest rooftop bar on Broadway."

"We’ve got it all: a tattoo shop, a mechanical bull, and every NFL game with Sunday Ticket, plus great food and drinks all day long," the website continued. "Every floor is decked out in Bon Jovi memorabilia, making JBJ’s the ultimate destination for music, history, dining, and entertainment — seven days a week."
Bon Jovi, 63, previously opened up about why he wanted to open the bar . "Well, this is Music City. This is where all kinds of musical styles have come together for decades now. It's a place that we're very familiar with. We've done several albums here. So many of our big hits were written here, and now we have a place to call home. So it's a little bit of New Jersey on the strip in Nashville," he told Backstage Country .
He also revealed he has many fond memories of Nashville, including when his band wrote the track "I Love This Town" featured on their 2007 album Lost Highway .
"I remember having a burger and a beer across the street on a Sunday morning, and one of the three of us said, 'I love this town.' And I went, check, please. We went home and when we wrote the song. So, you know, there's a lot of memories here," Bon Jovi shared.
